title: Cartier scalar unit as an exact-functor derived unit
statement: Let R and A be ordinary commutative rings in the sheaf universe, phi:R->A a unital ring map and Z any scheme. Let F be a pro-etale R-module sheaf on Z, H a pro-etale A-module sheaf and eta:F->restrict_phi(H). If GeoCartierScalarUnit(phi,Z,F,H,eta) holds [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface], then restriction_phi.DerivedUnit(F,H,eta) holds [def-sp-exact-functor-derived-unit]. This identifies the two actual Hom universal properties against every unbounded target complex, with the same map eta, without any choice of a derived extension object.

proof.text: Unfold GeoCartierScalarUnit and IsDerivedBaseChange. The derived restriction functor is definitionally the exact restriction functor mapDerivedCategory.

Unfold DerivedUnit. Associativity identifies the two parenthesizations of single(eta), the inverse exact-single comparison, and the restricted target morphism. The resulting Hom maps and their bijectivity predicates coincide.
